note: activity bar -- platform's own interface navigation icons for views, accounts, and settings
status bar -- platform's own interface controls and computed values for host, problems, ports, notifications, and editor state
tab group actions toolbar -- platform controls for splitting tabs and accessing more tab actions
notification action buttons container -- platform controls for notification actions like dismiss or learn more
tab close button -- platform control to close the active tab
notification clear button -- platform control to clear notifications
notification configure button -- platform control to open notification settings
